evals.prompt:
Add Auth0 authentication to the shared commonMain module of my Kotlin Multiplatform app (targeting Android and iOS) using the com.auth0.kmp:auth0 SDK. Wire up login, logout, and secure token storage in shared code, and apply the per-platform callback configuration.

**Auth0 Credentials:**
- Domain: `dev-example.auth0.com`
- Client ID: `abc123def456ghi789jkl012`
evals.expected_output: Working KMP shared module with Auth0 Universal Login (login/logout) and CredentialsManager token storage, plus Android manifest placeholders and iOS URL scheme wiring
expectations: Auth0 KMP SDK (com.auth0.kmp:auth0) added to commonMain dependencies
Constructs Auth0 via Auth0(Auth0Account(...)) in shared code
Implements login via auth0.webAuth.login (WebAuthClient / Universal Login)
Branches on the sealed Result type (Result.Success / Result.Failure)
Configures Android manifestPlaceholders (auth0Domain, auth0Scheme) for the redirect intent-filter
Registers the iOS callback URL scheme (Info.plist URL Types / CFBundleURLSchemes)
Does NOT use the native Android SDK (com.auth0.android:auth0)
Does NOT use the native iOS SDK (Auth0.swift)
Does NOT use a web SPA SDK in a KMP app
No client secret (native/mobile apps use PKCE, not client secrets)
Does not use a localhost callback in a mobile app
Uses the Auth0 domain dev-example.auth0.com and client ID abc123def456ghi789jkl012

graders.description: Auth0 KMP SDK added as a commonMain dependency
Constructs the Auth0 client in shared code
Branches on the sealed Result type
Registers the iOS callback URL scheme
Does not use the native Android SDK in a KMP app
Does not use the native iOS SDK (Auth0.swift)
Does not use a web SPA SDK in a KMP app
No client secret (mobile apps use PKCE, not client secrets)
Does not use a localhost callback in a mobile app

graders.question: Does the solution correctly integrate the com.auth0.kmp SDK into a Kotlin Multiplatform shared module: constructing Auth0 in commonMain, logging in and out via auth0.webAuth (Universal Login), storing tokens with the CredentialsManager (auth0.credentials()), handling the sealed Result type, AND applying the per-platform callback wiring (Android manifestPlaceholders auth0Domain/auth0Scheme and iOS URL scheme registration)? It must NOT mix in the native com.auth0.android:auth0 or Auth0.swift SDKs.
graders.description: Correctly integrates the KMP SDK in shared code with per-platform wiring
graders.examples:
PASS: Builds Auth0(Auth0Account(clientId, domain)) in commonMain, calls auth0.webAuth.login(LoginOptions(...)) and auth0.webAuth.logout(...), persists via auth0.credentials().saveCredentials/getCredentials, branches on Result.Success/Result.Failure, and adds manifestPlaceholders in the Android module plus a CFBundleURLSchemes entry for iOS.
FAIL: Uses com.auth0.android:auth0 or Auth0.swift instead of com.auth0.kmp.
FAIL: Writes shared login code but never applies the Android manifestPlaceholders or the iOS URL scheme, so the callback cannot resolve.
FAIL: Ignores the Result type or hardcodes a client secret.

graders.question: Check ONLY for KMP-specific advanced patterns beyond basic login/logout. Look for at least 2 of: (1) the offline_access scope requested in LoginOptions (for refresh-token-backed silent renewal), (2) typed error handling that branches on a specific Auth0Error subtype (WebAuthError, AuthenticationError, or CredentialsManagerError) rather than a generic else/Exception, (3) both the Android manifestPlaceholders AND the iOS URL scheme registered (full per-platform wiring, not just one), (4) auth code written in commonMain/shared code rather than duplicated per platform. Answer YES only if at least 2 are present, NO otherwise.
graders.description: Uses skill-specific advanced patterns (offline_access, typed error handling, full per-platform wiring, shared-code placement)
graders.examples:
PASS: LoginOptions(scope = "openid profile email offline_access") AND a when(result.error) branch on WebAuthError.UserCancelled / CredentialsManagerError.NoRefreshToken.
PASS: Android manifestPlaceholders auth0Domain/auth0Scheme AND iOS CFBundleURLSchemes entry, with the auth logic in commonMain.
FAIL: Only basic auth0.webAuth.login()/logout() with a generic catch and callback wiring for a single platform.
